messages:
jordan: Alert — initiating a temporary staged freeze of the release train due to higher-than-normal GPU evictions in us-west. Initial hold window ~36h, may shorten if infra health returns. Please avoid new submissions to the train for the next 60m. :triangular_flag_on_post:

deploy-bot: [autocheck] 14/50 canaries failing health checks in us-west. See internal dashboard: https://infra.internal/canaries

marie: We have an enterprise customer hotfix queued. What is the emergency exemption process?

jordan: @marie open a ticket on the release-train board labelled "hotfix-exception" and tag @release-coordinator + @ops-oncall. Exceptions only for verified P0 regressions. Triage target = 25 minutes.

ops-oncall: Note: Dedicated (reserved) pools are not impacted by the eviction cluster, but autoscaler may reassign non-reserved capacity. If you depend on committed throughput, escalate to #infra-allocations now. :warning:

kevin: Recommend teams with non-critical rollouts shift to the next train slot. Well proactively reassign canaries that are safe to move to eu-west/apac to keep validation progressing.

release-coordinator: Reassignment policy: we will only move canaries that do not require pinned hardware or locality. To keep a canary in us-west, comment on the canary ticket with `keep:us-west`. Reassigned owners will get an automated DM.

deploy-bot: Helpful command to inspect and request reassignment:
```
rictl canary list --team=<team> --filter=region:us-west
rictl canary reassign --id=<canary-id> --target=eu-west
```

jordan: I'll post a follow-up in 2h with a progress snapshot. Thanks for staying flexible — please flag any immediate blockers here. :blue_heart:
